meta.title: Restaurant ERP - Current Process Flow
meta.subtitle: Order + real stock | Shift handover | Owner-only privacy | Actual GST/accounts preserved. New shift/privacy: local QA, not deployed.

views.label: Full Flow
views.note: Current code map. Shift/privacy are QA-tested locally, not deployed; sample dashboard/report modules are not live totals.

views.label: Recipe, Production & Stock
views.note: Recipe save never changes inventory. Production credits real Semi-FG; sale consumes direct stock. Warehouse Receive credits branch stock.

views.label: Billing, GST & WhatsApp
views.note: Receipt and optional FX/GST; Accounts GSTR includes every eligible sale. WhatsApp is optional, best-effort text after commit.

views.label: Shift + Cash Handover
views.note: Manual closing opens next run. Accept handover before sale. Cash carries forward; digital receipts are per-run, not bank transfers.

views.label: Owner Privacy + Actual Accounts
views.note: Only operational reads are filtered. Owner and authorized official accounts retain actual records; cash reconciliation stays actual.

cards.title: 1. Order Capture - Branch POS
items: POS user selects table/takeaway, counter and same-branch sellable items, then confirms. This is the responsive POS screen, not a separate waiter app.
Branch/grant/session checks run server-side. A configured branch requires an open shift and accepted incoming handover before sale.

cards.title: 2. Recipe Builder — Define the Dish's Real Recipe (one-time setup)
items: Before anything can be sold, its recipe is saved once in Recipe Builder: the dish/Semi-FG name, branch, output unit (portion/kg/ltr/pcs), batch yield, and every ingredient row — each either a raw material OR an existing same-branch Semi-FG. The whole dish + recipe saves atomically in one go; saving a recipe never touches stock.

Example: Butter Chicken's recipe = 0.1kg Gravy (Semi-FG) + 0.25kg Chicken per portion. Gravy's own recipe = 0.3kg Tomato + 0.3kg Butter per 1kg produced. A cycle (Gravy needing itself, directly or through another Semi-FG) is rejected at save time.

cards.title: 3. Semi-FG Production — Real Prepared Stock, Not Virtual
items: A Semi-FG only becomes real, sellable stock after it is actually PRODUCED on the Production panel — pick the Semi-FG and an output quantity, Record production. This is the ONLY action that credits real prepared stock in Postgres (semi_fg_stock).

Production consumes the Semi-FG's OWN direct raw materials (and any nested Semi-FG) exactly once, then credits the produced quantity. Each production is idempotent and its history is immutable — a retried request never double-deducts or double-credits.

Example: Recording 1kg of Gravy production consumes 0.3kg Tomato + 0.3kg Butter from real branch inventory right then, and credits 1kg to Gravy's own Semi-FG stock — before this, Gravy's sellable stock is 0.

cards.title: 4. Stock Check Engine — Direct Raw + Produced Semi-FG Only
items: On Confirm Order, the system checks and atomically deducts ONLY the direct raw materials and any already-PRODUCED Semi-FG stock each line needs — it never walks back into a Semi-FG's own embedded raw ingredients a second time (no recursive/virtual deduction).

If a dish needs a Semi-FG that hasn't been produced yet, or produced stock is short, the WHOLE order is rejected with a clear message — never a partial sale, and the cashier is told to produce it first.

Example: Butter Chicken needs 0.1kg Gravy + 0.25kg Chicken per plate. Selling 10 plates needs 1kg Gravy stock (from Step 3's production) + 2.5kg Chicken — Gravy's own Tomato/Butter is never touched again at sale time.

cards.title: 5. Kitchen KOT + Semi-FG Stock Alert
items: Confirmed sale returns a KOT view containing item names and quantities without prices, alongside the billing receipt. Separate kitchen-device delivery or automatic printing is not claimed.
Use prepared-stock preview to identify Semi-FG shortage and record another batch. A scheduled automatic low-stock message is not established.

cards.title: 6. Central + Branch Warehouse
items: The Owner sets up one Central warehouse (bulk stock) and each branch gets its own local warehouse.
Example: Central dispatches 50 kg Chicken to Branch B2 — this is a paper record only; B2's actual stock has not changed yet.

cards.title: 7. Receive = the Real Stock Move
items: Dispatch is just a record; branch inventory only changes when the branch confirms Receive.
Example: B2 receives 48 kg (out of 50 dispatched) — B2's inventory now gets +48 kg, and the 2 kg shortfall is recorded separately, never hidden.

cards.title: 8. Auto Stock Deduction + Low Stock Alert
items: Sale atomically deducts direct raw + already-produced Semi-FG stock. Any shortage rejects the whole sale; embedded Semi-FG raw is not consumed again.
Inventory min/max badges identify configured raw-stock limits. Purchase & GRN remains an interactive demo; automatic purchase posting or alert sending is not claimed.

cards.title: 9. POS Receipt — 2 Billing Counters
items: Each order records Counter 1 or Counter 2. Both use the same branch stock and shift rules; this is counter attribution, not a separate independent cash drawer ledger.
Successful confirmation returns the real receipt and KOT. Displayed sales are today-scoped; latest 200 rows are listed while totals cover all completed sales in the same scope.

cards.title: 10. GST Invoice — CGST/SGST/IGST Auto-Split
items: When branch and company GST state codes are configured, billing computes GST and splits CGST/SGST or IGST. Unconfigured orders are billed without GST and excluded separately by the export.
Illustration only: taxable 300 at 5% yields 15 tax; intra-state split is 7.50 + 7.50. Tax configuration and filing review remain the business responsibility.

cards.title: 11. Multi-Currency — NRI / Export Billing
items: Optional non-INR tender requires an Owner-configured exchange rate. The sale snapshots that rate and payment amount; the invoice amount stays in INR.
Example: INR 363.20 / 84.50 gives USD 4.30 payment convenience. Later FX edits do not rewrite the saved sale.

cards.title: 12. Accounts -> GSTR Export - Actual Eligible Sales
items: GSTR Export is a tab inside Accounts, no separate sidebar item. Owner or a branch-scoped user explicitly granted OFFICIAL_SALES_REPORTS can view/download its HSN summary. POS_CASHIER alone is insufficient.

Owner-only operational orders remain included with every other eligible completed order. Missing GST setup is reported as excluded; privacy never changes tax/invoice totals. CSV is a summary for review, not a claim that filing has occurred.

cards.title: 13. WhatsApp Thank You Message
items: Optional customer phone triggers a best-effort ChatXFlow Thank You text after the order commits. Provider failure never rolls back the real sale; sent/failed outcome is displayed.
The text contains order number, total and branch. There is no generated invoice-link delivery implied, and a previously sent message cannot be recalled by later privacy changes.

cards.title: 14. WhatsApp Offer Campaign
items: Offer preview and send audience derive distinct customer contacts from actual past orders. Non-Owners exclude contacts found only on Owner-only orders; Owner sees the full scoped audience.
A send is an external side effect, separate from saving an order. This chart update sends no messages and creates no business records.

cards.title: 15. Shift Setup + Start - Local QA, Not Deployed
items: Owner can configure any branch; Branch Admin with SHIFT_MANAGEMENT only their own. Set 1-12 contiguous IST windows covering 24 hours; one same-start/end window covers a full day.

Start Shift selects the current window. A branch has one open run. A branch not configured retains legacy POS behavior; setup is required before real shift closing. Old definitions/history survive later edits.

cards.title: 16. Blind Count -> End Shift -> Next Run
items: Cashier or authorized operational user enters note/coin counts without expected cash. Manual End Shift saves the count and shortage/excess, ends the old run, opens its cyclic successor and creates a PENDING handover atomically.

Expected closing cash = accepted incoming counted cash + this run CASH sales. Example: received 500, new cash sales 300, count 790 -> expected 800 and shortage 10. The next shift receives physical 790.
Card/UPI/Other are current-run receipt summaries only, never accumulated bank transfers. Initial cash float and safe withdrawals are not modeled.

cards.title: 17. Accept Handover -> Repeat the Cycle
items: The incoming first authorized cashier sees actual Cash/Card/UPI/Other totals and must Accept Handover. POS and another closing remain blocked until acceptance; then the same operational cycle repeats.

A one-window branch opens a NEW run of the same window, never reuses the ended run ID. Time reminders are settings-only; time alone never closes a shift. Unknown closing outcome is not blindly retried.

cards.title: 18. Owner-only Privacy - Local QA, Not Deployed
items: Only Owner can mark a saved order Owner-only or restore staff visibility, with a reason. Visibility change and its audit entry commit together; repeated same-state requests do not create duplicate audit events.
Example: two 500 orders -> Owner sees actual 1000 / staff-visible 500 / private 500. Staff API/table returns only the visible order and labels 500 as access-filtered, not actual total.

cards.title: 19. Actual Accounting Is Never Filtered by Privacy
items: Private operational visibility never deletes sales, changes invoices/GST, reverses stock or reduces actual cash reconciliation. Official Accounts GSTR remains unfiltered under its separate grant.

Cash custodians and authorized official readers may infer actual aggregate amounts. Past views, printouts, screenshots, downloads and sent receipts cannot be revoked. Existing sample dashboards/reports are not live privacy-aware sales totals.

cards.title: 20. Real Accounts + Workforce Modules
items: Accounts stores categorized expenses and final payroll costs. Attendance, approved leave, employee rate history and payroll finalization have real DB-backed paths; branch and module grants control access.

Payroll uses actual calendar days, no weekly-off concept. Only approved paid ON_ROLL leave is paid; OFF_ROLL earns worked days. Missing attendance blocks finalization. P&L does not invent sales/COGS/net profit when those sources are unconnected.

cards.title: 21. System Boundaries + Release Status
items: Users/access, branches, branding, inventory, menu/recipes, Semi-FG production, warehouse receive, POS and provider settings have real persistence. Guide Book explains permissions and practice examples in English/Hinglish.
Dashboard, Reports, MIS, Tasks/Checklists and Purchase/GRN still include labelled sample/demo flows. Do not confuse their charts/actions with live accounting or automated task/PO engines.

Recipe Builder/Semi-FG release was deployed earlier. GSTR tab move, shifts and Owner-only privacy are current local changes; privacy migration 0009 is QA-only and main local DB still needs it. Full interactive browser acceptance has known tooling gaps. No deployment, migration, commit or push is done by updating this chart.
